{{Quote|When I cooked chow for a militia camp in the Lesser Plooriod Cluster, shaak pot roast was always very popular. I suppose it reminded lonely soldiers of the warmth of a good, home-cooked meal. Or maybe it was just better than the cans of Skakoan processed, additive-enhanced meat I served most other nights.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Skakoan processed, additive-enhanced meat''' was a type of heavily processed meat made by [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served it most nights during the time he served as cook for a [[Militia/Legends|milita]] camp in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]]; however, most of the camp preferred his [[Shaak pot roast]].

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Skakoan processed, additive-enhanced meat, SPAM for short, is a reference to the real-world canned processed meat product named [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spam_(food)?variant=zh-tw spam].<ref name="Dex">''{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}''</ref>
